# SEOryon AI Citability Grader

> Free, browser-based grader for whether AI search engines will cite your content.
> Paste an article and it returns a Citability Score — a heuristic grade of how
> likely ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI are to quote you — plus a
> prioritized, concrete rewrite fix-list. No signup, no upload, nothing sent to a
> server. Built by SEOryon.

The grader runs entirely client-side: your text is analyzed in the browser and
never leaves the page. It scores the passage-level, answer-first,
clearly-attributed structure that AI engines pull into their answers, then tells
you exactly what to change to raise the score.

## Docs

- [The grader](https://cite.seoryon.com): the tool itself — paste text, get a score and fix-list
- [How it works](https://cite.seoryon.com/#how): the factors behind the Citability Score
- [FAQ](https://cite.seoryon.com/#faq): what the score measures and how to act on it
